stage: V35: forecast-error likelihood check, then fixed-control paired replay
frozen_before: New-model validation scores and V35 policy replays
data_status: Previously developed retrospective dates, disjoint from V34 six-date decision panel; not pristine confirmation.
messages: Local raw archives; V34 extractor, 600-second sampling, 07:00 to 09:40; availability=max(capture,header,TripUpdate timestamp). No actual label substitutes for a prediction.
fit_queries: Each source physical endpoint once, cutoff=scheduled-300; REAL and cutoff<actual, latest valid numeric forecast available by cutoff. Fit uses training dates only.

candidate.name: fitted_error_gaussian
candidate.parameters: For each event kind, pooled first and second error moments; route/kind moments shrunk toward kind pool with pseudocount 20. Center=forecast+shrunk mean; scale=max(30,sqrt(shrunk second moment-mean squared)). Unseen routes use the kind pool.
candidate.joint_model: Unchanged V5 physical trip prior, transition, grid and cancellation model. Multiply one latest Gaussian emission per unobserved endpoint. Conditional independence of different endpoint forecast errors is a working assumption to test, not an established fact.
candidate.no_additional_variants: No bandwidth, bias, endpoint-selection, tempering or correlation parameter tuning on validation or V34 outcomes. No future forecast generator.

validation.endpoint_panel: Known REAL endpoints at scheduled-300 with actual>cutoff, including endpoints without a numeric message; score the common physical trip posterior.
validation.onboard_panel: Every supported contiguous pair of same-vehicle connections with measured chronological endpoints. At first-leg arrival, reveal that leg's departure and arrival and only messages already received; predict the next leg's arrival. Selection uses topology and label coverage, not error or method advantage.
validation.aggregation: Retain every row, unsupported history and date. Report date means and equal-date macro means on common supported queries; no independent-endpoint confidence intervals.
validation.model_retention_gate: No increased unsupported queries; onboard macro CRPS strictly below legacy and no worse than own_only; onboard Brier no worse than legacy; onboard 90% coverage absolute deviation from 0.90 no worse than legacy. This is a development retention rule, not G2.
validation.failure_action: Keep the failed model and receipts as diagnostic evidence; do not promote it or tune it using V34. The predeclared paired replay below still measures its decision consequences.

paired_replay.cohort: All unchanged 72 V34 roots, actual endpoints, menus, MCT, deadline and public message stream.
paired_replay.information: Identical received public messages and own/local observations for all three controllers. Model change only. Reuse original legacy-message and own-only cheap-control results; no repeat of old rollout banks.
paired_replay.rollout: Unchanged V34 disagreement trigger, continuation and finite-bank decision rule. 128 shared conditional worlds per actual disagreement; seed=34050+1000*root_index+call_index; no retry or refinement. All unresolved draws retained. Snapshot retains fitted model and excludes future archives.
paired_replay.timing: Cold model construction, message processing, posterior, scoring, all sampling and continuation charged. IO/graph preparation separate; physical actions use logical clocks.
paired_replay.comparisons: Each fitted control vs the same legacy control, and fitted rollout vs both fixed fitted cheap controls. Retain every positive, negative and tied root; no root-wise oracle baseline.

stop: This stage tests one observation model and existing controls. A predictive gain, a local repair or standard rollout gain alone is not a novel algorithm or G2. No new large DP/search is launched in this stage.
